questions.stem: Which formula correctly calculates the energy transferred by an electrical device?
questions.explanation: Energy transferred (E) equals power (P) multiplied by time (t): E = Pt. If power is in watts and time in seconds, energy is in joules. If power is in kilowatts and time in hours, energy is in kilowatt-hours (kWh).
1 kWh = 1000 W x 3600 s = 3,600,000 J = 3.6 MJ. The kilowatt-hour is a large unit of energy used for billing purposes because the joule is too small for measuring household energy consumption.
